# bb reviewer-group

Create, list and change reviewer groups and their members

5 commands.

[`bb reviewer-group create`](#bb-reviewer-group-create)
:   Create a reviewer group

[`bb reviewer-group delete`](#bb-reviewer-group-delete)
:   Delete a reviewer group

[`bb reviewer-group list`](#bb-reviewer-group-list)
:   List reviewer groups

[`bb reviewer-group update`](#bb-reviewer-group-update)
:   Update a reviewer group

[`bb reviewer-group users`](#bb-reviewer-group-users)
:   List the members of a repository reviewer group who can see the repository

## `bb reviewer-group create`

Create a reviewer group

```text
bb reviewer-group create <name> [flags]
```

```bash
# A group of reviewers for one repository
bb reviewer-group create backend-team --repo PROJ/repo --users alice,bob

# For every repository of a project
bb reviewer-group create backend-team --project PROJ --users alice,bob \
  --description "Owners of the backend services"
```

`--description string`
:   Description of the reviewer group

`--users strings`
:   Members by username (repeatable or comma-separated); required, because Bitbucket refuses a reviewer group with no members

Inherited from [`bb reviewer-group`](#bb-reviewer-group):

`--project string`
:   Project key

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

**Dry run:** Checks your permission and the current state this depends on, without changing anything (preconditions-checked)

  scope?           PROJECT|REPOSITORY  PROJECT when the group is defined on the project, REPOSITORY when on the
                                       repository itself.

</code></pre>

## `bb reviewer-group delete`

Delete a reviewer group

```text
bb reviewer-group delete <reviewer-group-id> [flags]
```

```bash
# By the id bb reviewer-group list prints
bb reviewer-group delete 4 --repo PROJ/repo
```

## `bb reviewer-group update`

Update a reviewer group

```text
bb reviewer-group update <reviewer-group-id> [flags]
```

```bash
# Replace the members of a group
bb reviewer-group update 4 --repo PROJ/repo --users alice,bob,carol

# Rename it, keeping the members
bb reviewer-group update 4 --repo PROJ/repo --name platform-team
```

`--description string`
:   New description of the reviewer group

`--name string`
:   New name of the reviewer group

`--users strings`
:   Replace the members with these usernames (repeatable or comma-separated); omit to keep the current members

Inherited from [`bb reviewer-group`](#bb-reviewer-group):

`--project string`
:   Project key

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).

## `bb reviewer-group users`

List the members of a repository reviewer group who can see the repository

```text
bb reviewer-group users <reviewer-group-id>
```

Bitbucket leaves out a member without access to the repository, whom it still keeps in the group. bb reviewer-group list names every member.

```bash
# The members of a group who can see the repository
bb reviewer-group users 4 --repo PROJ/repo
```

Inherited from [`bb reviewer-group`](#bb-reviewer-group):

`--project string`
:   Project key

`--repo string`
:   Repository as PROJECT/slug

Also takes the [global flags](global-flags.md).
